lane.name: H10-1 basement-step ridge
lane.single_method_paragraph: Rank cells by the gradient magnitude of Gaussian-smoothed log(depth-to-basement + 50 m) (band 15, sigma 2 px); keep the top K = 60,988 ridge cells as a continuous rank ramp in (0, 1]; zero everywhere else and on catalogue cells.

hypothesis: H10-1: a narrow ridge of depth-to-basement gradient marks fault-displaced basement steps rather than broad basin shoulders (docs/HYPOTHESES_S10.md)
mechanism: Faults that offset sedimentary basement produce narrow lateral steps in depth to basement (band 15); basin-margin flexure gives broad gentle gradients.
named_non_fault_mimic: Basin-margin flexure and onlap produce ridge-like gradients that look like steps.
